The background shows a white door, a cat tree, and various household items. A small circular inset in the upper right displays a smiling woman. (2) The perspective shifts to a closer view of the boy and the woman. The woman is holding a smartphone, presenting a menu with multiple images of pasta dishes. The boy leans in, looking intently at the screen and using his index finger to point and touch specific food items. A basket filled with wooden toys and miscellaneous items sits on the floor beside him. (3) The setting changes to a restaurant with wooden tables and large glass windows revealing an urban street outside. The boy is now wearing a white bib with a rainbow pattern and sits at the table.
